'''Minik''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Security officer/Legends|security officer]] aboard the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']], a [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], in the early days of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Officer Minik was assigned to guard [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Oteg]]'s briefing room aboard the ''Telos''.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Security Officer Minik appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the couriers for the Republic faction's mission "The Jedi Prisoner," if players have not already acquired the mission from Oteg's droid [[MP-77]].<ref name="TOR" />
